projectDescription: Diskograf is a community-powered music credits database for Malaysian music, letting fans, artists, and industry professionals discover, document, and verify the people and stories behind every song.
keyFeatures: Searchable catalogue of Malaysian songs, artists, and record labels
Detailed song credits — composers, lyricists, producers, performers
Artist profile pages with full discography and genre filtering
Label pages with full release counts and company information
Community contributions — fans and industry members can add and correct credits
Artist identity claims — verified artists can own their catalogue profile
Curated lists built by editors and contributors
Advanced search with filters for artist, label, year, decade, and genre
Changelog of platform improvements and new features
publicApiSurface: Search syntax: song title (plain text), artist: / a:, label: / l:, year: / y:, decade: / d:
